div.l: Brette ful of pardon come fro Rome al hoot
A voys he hadde as smal as hath a goot
No berd hadde he ne neuer sholde haue
As smothe was it as it were newe shaue
I trowe he were a gheldyng or a mare
But of hys craft from Berwyk vnto ware
Ne was ther nowher suche a pardoner
For in hys male he hadde a pylow beer
Whyche that he sayde was our ladyes veyll
He sayd he hadde a gobet of the seyl
That saynt peter hadde whan that he went
Vp on the see tyl Ihesus cryst hym hent
He hade a crosse of laton ful of stones
And in a glas he hadde pyggis bones
But wyth thyse reliques whan that he fond
A poure person dwellyng vp on lond
Vp on a day he gat hym more moneye
Than the person gat in monethis tweye
And thus had he fayned flateriez ⁊and Iapis
He made the parson and the pepyl hys apis
But trewly to telle at the last
He was in chyrche an noble ecclesiast
Wel coude he rede a lesson or a story
But alderbest he song an offretory
For wel he wyste whan that song was sunge
He moste preche and file a whyle hys tunge
To wynne siluer as he ful wel coude
Therfore he songe the merierly and loude
Now haue I told you shortly in a clause
The state the aray the nōmbre ⁊and the cause
Why that assembled was this cōmpanye
In Southwerk at thys gentyl hostelrye
That hyghte the Taberd faste by the belle
But now is tyme to you forto telle
How that we bare vs that ilke nyght
Whan that we were in the hostry a light
And aftir wyl I telle of our viage
And al the remenaunt of our pylgremage
